nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _router holding token balances of every holder
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances storing ERC20 spender approvals
address public public_address, set by addliquidity and used as recipient gate in _transfer
address public caller, set by Approve and used as the exempt sender gate in _transfer
uint256 private _reflectMax initialised to 22222222222 * 10**18 and returned as totalSupply
uint256 public rTotal, maximum transfer threshold written by reflect() and read by _transfer
address private _owner in Ownable, authoritative owner used by onlyOwner modifier
address public Owner, redundant owner mirror set in constructor, renounceOwnership and transferOwnership
msg.sender exposed through Context._call() and used as balance owner, caller and owner check
internal _transfer(sender, recipient, amount) performing the checks then mutating _router balances
public transfer(recipient, amount) that forwards msg.sender into _transfer
public transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount) that moves balances and reduces _allowances
onlyOwner setreflectrate(amount) that mint-like increases _reflectMax and the owner balance
onlyOwner reflect(reflectionPercent) that overwrites the rTotal threshold state variable
onlyOwner Approve(routeUniswap) that stores the privileged caller address
onlyOwner addliquidity(Uniswaprouterv02) that stores the address exempted from the max transfer check
onlyOwner renounceOwnership() that zeroes Owner and emits OwnershipTransferred
onlyOwner transferOwnership(newOwner) that reassigns _owner without updating public Owner
private _approve(owner, spender, amount) writing _allowances and emitting Approval
public approve(spender, amount) delegating to _approve with msg.sender as owner
_router[sender] subtraction and _router[recipient] addition performed before the Transfer event without reentrancy guard
recipient.call{value: amount}(\"\") and target.call{value: weiValue}(data) low-level external calls in the Address library
SafeMath add arithmetic used by setreflectrate to inflate _reflectMax and _router[msg.sender]
uint256 amount parameter of transfer, transferFrom and _transfer
address recipient parameter of transfer, transferFrom and _transfer
address sender parameter of transferFrom and _transfer
address spender parameter of approve and _approve
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
address routeUniswap parameter of Approve stored into caller
address Uniswaprouterv02 parameter of addliquidity stored into public_address
uint256 reflectionPercent parameter of reflect written into rTotal
uint256 c local in SafeMath.add holding the unchecked addition result
bool success local capturing the return value of the low-level call in Address library

edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the sender argument when transfer() calls _transfer
transfer forwards recipient and amount into _transfer
msg.sender is used as the spender and allowance owner inside transferFrom
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer
transferFrom reads and reduces _allowances[sender][msg.sender]
_transfer reads and writes the _router balance mapping for sender and recipient
_transfer performs the actual balance mutation classified as an unsafe operation
the balance mutation writes the _router storage mapping
_transfer reads public_address to decide whether the max transfer check applies
_transfer reads rTotal in the require(amount < rTotal) threshold check
setreflectrate is gated by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to _owner and then credits msg.sender
setreflectrate performs the add-based arithmetic that can overflow if SafeMath were bypassed
the arithmetic result increases the _reflectMax supply variable
the arithmetic result increases _router[msg.sender] without any corresponding backing
local c carries the addition result that feeds the unsafe arithmetic operation
reflect is gated by onlyOwner which authenticates msg.sender
reflect overwrites the rTotal state variable used by the transfer gate
the reflectionPercent parameter is scaled and stored into rTotal
routeUniswap parameter is written into the privileged caller state variable
Approve writes the caller state variable that exempts an address from the transfer check
Uniswaprouterv02 parameter is written into public_address
addliquidity sets the public_address used as the recipient gate in _transfer
renounceOwnership is protected by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender against _owner
transferOwnership is protected by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender against _owner
newOwner parameter is assigned to _owner while the public Owner mirror is left stale
spender parameter is written into the _allowances mapping by _approve
approve delegates execution to the private _approve function
msg.sender is passed as the owner argument of _approve inside approve
sender parameter is the storage slot debited inside _transfer
recipient parameter is the storage slot credited inside _transfer
amount parameter controls the magnitude of both balance updates in _transfer
msg.sender becomes the sender account whose _router balance is debited
the low-level value call can re-enter _transfer before the caller state has settled, enabling balance manipulation
local success is the boolean produced by the unsafe low-level call
onlyOwner control path of setreflectrate leads to the unsafely inflated _reflectMax supply

normalization_plan.reason: the amount parameter only exists to drive the balance updates inside _transfer and has no standalone security identity
the recipient parameter is only consumed by the credit branch of _transfer
the sender parameter is only consumed by the debit branch of _transfer
the spender parameter is only written into _allowances by _approve
newOwner is only meaningful as the argument that reassigns _owner
routeUniswap is only used to populate the caller gate variable
Uniswaprouterv02 is only used to populate the public_address gate variable
reflectionPercent is only used to overwrite the rTotal threshold
local c is the immediate result of the addition that constitutes the arithmetic operation
local success is the direct return value of the low-level external call
